newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court quashes two CVRD injunctions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court quashes two CVRD injunctions.

text.p: A federal court in Rio de Janeiro overturned two of three injunctions blocking the sale of mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a court spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman for the Regional Federal Tribunal (TRF) in Rio said one injunction against the sale remained outstanding in the southern state of Rio Grande do Sul.
Delayed since April 29, the auction of up to 45 percent of CVRD's voting stock was tentatively rescheduled for today.
But first the two Rio injunctions and the court order in Rio Grande do Sul had to be revoked.
The government won an important legal victory Monday night when a high court judge in Brasilia overturned a host of other injunctions.
